column1: # Columns: case, metric, reference value (throughput MB/s, latency ns/call),
# A run fails when it is worse than reference*margin (throughput) or
# better-is-lower reference/margin (latency). Journal every change here.
# VALUES are the quiet-box baseline of 2026-08-09 (results-ubuntubudu-20260809.md),
# deliberately NOT re-baselined: the 2026-08-09 re-run that produced the margins
# below reproduced every one of them within 2% (a 2201 vs 2192, b 1968 vs 1970,
# c 390 vs 389, f 158 vs 159, h 1323 vs 1303), so there was nothing to move and
# moving them would have quietly ratcheted the baseline down.
# MARGINS are per case, from that run's trial spread (R3.5, D17):
# The ceiling is fixed, not derived — the box's noise floor is ~10% even at
# median-of-7, so no single run's tightness justifies gating below it.
